description:
Log the sender's time on a live project in this workspace.

Before writing, call well_list_projects and match the named project to its returned live project_id. If more than one project matches, reply with numbered choices and wait for the sender to pick one. Call this tool only after one project is resolved. This tool never searches for a project or returns candidate choices.

Pass project_id, duration_seconds and day when the sender named a day. day uses YYYY-MM-DD and defaults to today in the sender's time zone unless also_in_harvest is true; a Harvest request must name its day. duration_seconds is a positive whole number. The sender is the person whose hours are logged. A live project and sender must still belong to this workspace. A complete typed request that names Harvest confirms the local save; the Harvest entry is sent only after the person approves its card.

Set also_in_harvest only when the sender explicitly asked to log this time in Harvest. Pass harvest_workspace_connector_id from a live Harvest row in well_list_connectors when available. The Harvest bridge call must include the returned activity_id outside its args. The bridge reads active Harvest task assignments before it writes and asks the sender to choose if several match.

The receipt states the saved day, the project's week total from activity.week.total_hours, and its sources from activity.week.source_ids. It names a source only when source_ids holds one source; with two it states the total and names no source until the mixed-week wording is decided.

also_in_harvest.description: Set only when the person's complete typed request names Harvest too.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

day.description: The activity day, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today in the sender's time zone.

duration_seconds.description: The time the sender logged, in whole seconds.

harvest_workspace_connector_id.description: The live Harvest connection id from well_list_connectors, when one is connected.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A retried write with the same key returns the original result instead of re-applying the operation.

project_id.description: The public id of a live project returned by well_list_projects.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several — a write lands in exactly one workspace and this call would not say which.

workspace_scope.description: Restrict this call to the family: the token's primary workspace plus the company workspaces under it that you are a member of. Unrelated authorized workspaces drop out of the read; row reads merge across the family, while a per-workspace figure still reports exactly one workspace.

name: well_create_activity

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.

newly_connected.description: Tools that connected to this workspace since the last result and that no session was told about yet, oldest first. Present only when at least one tool is new. The connected-line rule says when to tell an entry; when it does, one line per entry, in the person's language: "<name> is connected.". Never fold several entries into one sentence. Each entry comes back once, on one result only: never repeat its line later.

title: Create activity
